policy.accuracy: conditional on complete conversations; no incomplete prefixes or unobserved future turns included
policy.strict: tool_use_correct AND instruction_following AND kb_grounding; turn-taking reported separately
policy.confidence_interval: 20000 whole-conversation bootstrap resamples; excludes judge uncertainty and differences in capture date/SDK/serving
policy.text_latency: first scripted response excluded; recorded recovery responses included; positive finite service timings; linear P95
policy.voice_latency: all turns; positive measurable actual first speech; signed and missing diagnostics preserved
policy.source_preservation: selected original sources, immutable input snapshots, original voice quality records, and original per-turn audio JSON verified byte-for-byte
policy.provider_rejections: explicit unscored dispositions; any incomplete quality cohort has null headline accuracy/error rates/CIs; source membership and latency retained
policy.cost: SDK-reported successful-request costs; operational attempts without usage metadata are not assigned an invented cost

data.complete_means: every selected conversation has a valid quality grade; processing_complete tracks terminal dispositions separately
